The total of about 45 uA (80 uW) is under 150 uW. A 3-stage ring with about 4 fF per node gives f_mid of about 600 MHz, twice the requirement. A full-swing CMOS buffer plus a small feed-forward cap from the buffer input to vout pushes vout tens of mV past each rail, which gives a swing above 1.82 V."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Lf":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),      # starving footer length [um]
    "Wf":   (0.42, 0.42, 1.5),    # starving footer width [um]
    "Wn":   (0.42, 0.42, 1.0),    # ring inverter NMOS width
    "Wp":   (0.84, 0.42, 2.0),    # ring inverter PMOS width
    "Wb1":  (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),     # middle buffer NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
    "Wb2":  (1.5, 0.42, 4.0),     # output buffer NMOS width (PMOS = 2.5x)
    "Cff":  (3e-15, 0.5e-15, 1.2e-14),  # feed-forward overshoot cap b1->vout
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vlo, vhi = spec["vctrl_range"]
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    VDD = 1.8
    L = 0.15
    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")

    # ---- 3-stage NMOS-starved ring ----
    N = 3
    nodes = ["x0", "x1", "x2"]
    for i in range(N):
        a = nodes[i]
        y = nodes[(i + 1) % N]
        n.M(f"MP{i}", y, a, "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], L)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", y, a, f"s{i}", "vss", "nfet", p["Wn"], L)
        n.M(f"MF{i}", f"s{i}", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wf"], p["Lf"])

    # ---- output buffer: small -> medium -> output, with overshoot cap ----
    n.M("MB0P", "b0", "x0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.84, L)
    n.M("MB0N", "b0", "x0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, L)
    n.M("MB1P", "b1", "b0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0 * p["Wb1"], L)
    n.M("MB1N", "b1", "b0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wb1"], L)
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.5 * p["Wb2"], L)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wb2"], L)
    n.C("CFF", "b1", "vout", p["Cff"])

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cox = 8.5e-15  # F/um^2 (approx, sky130 1.8V)
    cnode = (cox * (p["Wn"] + p["Wp"]) * L          # next-stage gate
             + 1.0e-15 * (p["Wn"] + p["Wp"])          # drain junctions/overlap
             + 0.5e-15)                               # wiring
    cnode_avg = cnode + 1.2e-15 / N                   # buffer tap load spread

    def fosc(vc):
        op = lut.op("n", p["Wf"], p["Lf"], vc, 0.3)
        I = max(op["Id"], 1e-9)
        tf = cnode_avg * 0.5 * VDD / I * 1.6          # starved fall
        tr = cnode_avg * 0.5 * VDD / 60e-6            # unstarved PMOS rise
        return 1.0 / (N * (tf + tr) + 30e-12)

    f_lo, f_mid, f_hi = fosc(vlo), fosc(vmid), fosc(vhi)

    # power: switched charge + crowbar estimate
    cbuf = (cox * L * (1.26 + 3.0 * p["Wb1"] + 3.5 * p["Wb2"])
            + 1.0e-15 * (1.26 + 3.0 * p["Wb1"] + 3.5 * p["Wb2"])
            + p["Cff"] + 20e-15)                      # assume ~20 fF CL
    c_sw = N * cnode + cbuf
    i_avg = c_sw * VDD * f_mid * 1.3 + 3e-6
    power = VDD * i_avg

    swing = VDD + 2 * 0.015

    return n, {"f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
               "tuning_ratio": f_hi / f_lo,
               "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo),
               "swing": swing, "power": power}
```
